source_identity_note: Existing methods retained from fb3c234; updated literal upstream e383c3c fixtures and appended its 49 observer methods. Source hashes identify exact original Git blobs; PID dictionary keys are restored after JSON transport in the inspect capture.
scope: Every declared method in tests/test_session_sleep.py and tests/test_close_finished_spaces.py, plus the six explicit dynamic attachments to CleanupPolicyTests. Inherited reruns are not duplicated as new declarations.
execution_claim: Source correspondence only. Actual executed, skipped and platform results are documented separately in docs/native-rust-migration.md.

methods.notes: Removed internal Python helper path is replaced by the native session-sleep-stub entrypoint; original event order, key sequence, ticket argv/session and label assertions are preserved.

methods.platform_requirement: Successful stub handover assertions are cfg(unix). The cross-platform supplemental case invokes the related agent_env helper. This entry does not claim Windows successful stub resume or platform execution.
cfg(unix) real disposable PTY. Windows original unsupported select failure has separate tests in stub_windows.rs; those are not successful-resume equivalence evidence.
cfg(unix) real disposable PTYs, including 1500 Korean characters with ICRNL enabled. Source mapping only; no execution claim.

methods.notes: Actual native install_session_sleep CLI uses fake launchctl in scratch HOME; checks own SLEEP label, dry-run, native command slot, installed executable and session_sleep_stub --help availability. Native entrypoint substitutes removed internal Python helper/file-list availability.

Matches original mocked runner boundary using UTF-8 replacement-decoded truncated bytes and checks argv plus parsed rows. Not an actual ps/platform execution claim; native execute uses String::from_utf8_lossy.

Original monkeypatch raises RuntimeError in pure focus after close; native adapter intentionally panics at the next pane and catch_unwind verifies identical pending-record preservation and next-cycle retry assertions. Normal Result::Err is not equated with panic.
cycle_with_inspector injects the original inspection exception before exclusion checks; t3 remains excluded and its first lookup-failed reason is asserted unchanged.

The actual CLI persistence body is shared through run_with_adapter_with_clock. Scratch state/log files and a fixed fixture clock verify skip does not increment errors and three healthy cycles clear the counter.
